value_or_angle: old="What was your main source material?" header="What was your main source material?" body="My family had a copy of Edward Hooker's epic genealogy of the descendants of Rev. Thomas Hooker, published in 1909 and completed by Margaret Huntington Hooker after Edward died. The book answered a lot of questions and is the backbone of research for this project. Each of the major founding Hartford families has its own genealogy, and I used those along with online resources like FamilySearch and Ancestry." category=education
